Free consultation

30 minutes with our team. Free.

Talk with the MASAR team, in Arabic or English, about any aviation question, especially becoming a pilot and ATPL training.

Cost

Free introductory call

Length

30 minutes

With

The MASAR team

Language

Arabic or English

Where

Online video call

Bring

All your questions

Who it suits

Is this call for you?

  • You’re thinking about becoming a pilot and don’t know where to start.
  • You’re comparing Europe and the USA, or two programmes.
  • You have an offer from a school and want to know what to ask.
  • You’re changing career and need to plan around work and income.

The call is guidance for planning. It is not a medical, visa or eligibility assessment.

Before the call

Bring all your questions.

Ask as much as you like. Write your questions down before the call so nothing gets missed. For example:

  • “Which route makes sense if I want to fly in the Gulf?”
  • “Is my budget realistic for training in Europe?”
  • “What should I check in this school’s offer?”

Book a time

Choose your language, then a time.

You will see the times in your own time zone, and get a confirmation with options to reschedule or cancel.
